narrative.summary: Benin governs AI through its National AI and Big Data Strategy 2023-2027, approved by the Council of Ministers in January 2023, and a July 2026 decree that makes the new Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation responsible for the national AI strategy, AI legislation and AI regulatory sandboxes. The 2018 Digital Code sets rules on automated decisions and impact assessments and punishes publishing manipulated montages of a person without consent. There is no AI-specific law or regulator guidance yet.

instruments.official_title: Stratégie Nationale d'Intelligence Artificielle et des Mégadonnées 2023-2027
instruments.english_title: National Artificial Intelligence and Big Data Strategy 2023-2027
instruments.issuing_authority: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation (Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation); approved by the Council of Ministers
instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation
instruments.summary: Benin's national AI and big data strategy (SNIAM), drafted by the Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation and approved by the Council of Ministers on 18 January 2023, sets the vision of making Benin by 2027 a country that capitalises on its massive data through AI systems. It is organised in three strategic orientations and four programmes (high-impact AI solutions in education, health, agriculture, living environment and tourism; skills; research, innovation and cooperation; and an AI and big data governance framework) with 123 actions over three phases. Programme 4 provides for a text on AI ethics and liability (including AI impact assessments over the life cycle) to be added to the Code du numérique and Penal Code, and a controlled environment for AI initiatives based on Articles 406-408 of the Code du numérique pending an AI regulatory body.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Benin's only national AI strategy; sets out the planned AI governance, ethics and sandbox framework.
instruments.current_status: Adopted: the Council of Ministers approved the SNIAM 2023-2027 at its session of Wednesday 18 January 2023 (Council of Ministers report of 18 January 2023, item II-3, and ministry news item of 18/01/2023; the strategy's foreword repeats this). On 8 November 2023 the Council of Ministers authorised feasibility studies to operationalise its four programmes, including the adoption of regulations on AI ethics and liability and a controlled environment for AI initiatives. Since Decree No. 2026-396 of 1 July 2026, responsibility for the national AI strategy lies with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation. An official English version (68 pages) is published on the ministry document portal and by ASIN. No implementation report, AI ethics regulation or successor strategy was found.

instruments.official_title: Loi n° 2017-20 du 20 avril 2018 portant code du numérique en République du Bénin
instruments.english_title: Law No. 2017-20 of 20 April 2018 on the Digital Code of the Republic of Benin
instruments.issuing_authority: Assemblée nationale (National Assembly); promulgated by the President of the Republic
instruments.publisher_name: Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation
instruments.summary: Benin's Digital Code covers electronic communications, electronic trust services, e-commerce, personal data protection (Book V, establishing the Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel, APDP) and cybercrime. Article 401 prohibits court decisions assessing a person's behaviour from being based on automated processing, including profiling, and bars decisions with legal or similarly significant effects based solely on automated processing intended to evaluate personality aspects, with exceptions for contracts and legal provisions; data subjects must be told of automated decision-making and its logic, and a data protection impact assessment is required before systematic automated evaluation, including profiling, with legal or similar effects. Article 576 punishes publishing online, without consent, a montage of a person's words or image unless it is evidently or expressly flagged as a montage (5 years and CFA 25 million), a rule applied to AI-manipulated images.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: General law with explicit automated decision-making and profiling rules that govern AI use on personal data; cited by the SNIAM as the basis for AI governance and a controlled AI environment (Arts. 406-408).
instruments.current_status: In force. Adopted by the National Assembly on 13 June 2017, brought into conformity with the Constitution after Constitutional Court decisions DCC 17-223 and DCC 18-019, and promulgated on 20 April 2018. Amended by Loi n° 2020-35 du 06 janvier 2021 (Articles 121, 125 and 464: organs of the telecoms regulator and composition of the APDP), which does not change the automated-decision provisions. The SNIAM (action 4.1) plans to add AI ethics and liability provisions; no such amendment was found. A revision ('relecture') of the Code was discussed at National Assembly workshops in November 2024 (focused on Article 550 on online harassment); no revision bill was found.

instruments.official_title: Décret n° 2026-396 du 1er juillet 2026 portant attributions, organisation et fonctionnement du Ministère de la Transformation digitale et de l'Innovation, en charge de la Stratégie nationale d'Intelligence artificielle
instruments.english_title: Decree No. 2026-396 of 1 July 2026 on the powers, organisation and functioning of the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation, in charge of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy
instruments.issuing_authority: Président de la République (President of the Republic), on the proposal of the Minister of Digital Transformation and Innovation
instruments.summary: Decree setting the mission and structure of the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Innovation, which is expressly 'in charge of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy'. Article 3 tasks it with drafting, updating and steering the national AI strategy across uses, governance, ethics and skills, drafting legislation and regulations on digital and AI, designing and running regulatory sandboxes for digital and AI, and representing Benin in international AI fora; Article 4 gives the minister a technical adviser on AI and Article 6 makes a directorate responsible for operational implementation of the AI strategy in State projects. It repeals, for the matters it covers, Decree No. 2021-308 on the former Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Designates the ministry responsible for national AI strategy, AI law-making and AI regulatory sandboxes.
instruments.current_status: In force from signature on 1 July 2026 (Art. 29), signed by President Romuald Wadagni; listed on the SGG decree database (published 29.07.2026). Repeals Decree No. 2021-308 of 9 June 2021 (Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation) for the matters covered; to be published in the Journal officiel.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: National law, the government, ministries and regulators were searched, including the Digital Code, the government's legal database and the data protection authority.
